metadata.scope: Pauli-error-frame model only; no hardware or threshold inference

oracle.scope: One isolated noiseless weight-4 X or Z check using the source's ancilla/reset/H/CNOT/readout structure; exact state-vector branches. Not a full surface-code circuit.
oracle.interpretation: Same XOR parity distribution does not imply same postmeasurement instrument. Production fitted routine models pair_bits as Pauli-frame flips, not Born measurements of the data state.
